Chapter 446: Chapter 14 The Eighth Shuttle (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 446: Chapter 14 The Eighth Shuttle (Subscription Request)_2

At the very least, the genetic stock of the Lin Family should be decent, right?

But when the time truly came to step onto the path of evolution, it was unsurprisingly met with a fatal blow.

Seeing that Lu Qiong also struggled with cultivation, Lin Shoucheng didn’t know why, but he felt slightly relieved.

“Still, we need to make an effort.”

Lin Yuan said.

Unless absolutely necessary, Lin Yuan would not let his parents undergo that life-extending transformation technology.

...

“Work hard, work hard.”

“Both of us will definitely make an effort.”

Lin Shoucheng nodded, who wouldn’t want to become a powerful Evolver traversing the stars?

Now that his own son had become a Star Lord, the cultivation conditions of the two of them were envied by many Evolvers, naturally, they would cultivate diligently.

“Xiaoyuan, you should also rest more often.”

“Don’t work too hard, the Fringe Starfield is also dangerous.”

After chatting for a bit, Lu Qiong reminded him with concern.

“Yes, Xiaoyuan, is it really necessary to go to that Fringe Starfield?”

Lin Shoucheng muttered.

He still hoped that his son would stay in the Chikun Star Domain.

How dangerous is the Fringe Starfield? Those violent Different Species…

“It is indeed essential.”

Lin Yuan nodded with a smile.

In fact, with Lin Yuan’s current identity, especially as the founder of Martial Tao,

he was eligible to apply to be exempted from the task of garrisoning the Fringe Starfield.

Though the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was currently at the Seventh Rank, its potential was rated higher than some Eighth Layer Evolutionary Paths.

Lin Yuan was not an Evolution Scholar, yet he surpassed one.

If he really applied to the Goddess of Wisdom, it would surely be approved.

However, that would be too conspicuous.

Lin Yuan obediently heading to the Fringe Starfield to garrison, even if he was targeted for assassination by Different Species, at most he would be invincible up to the Eighth Layer.

But if Lin Yuan did not garrison the Fringe Starfield, who knows what would happen? The top seers among the Different Species would likely discern some information from traces.

At that time, Lin Yuan might face an even more dangerous situation.

Even the Chikun Star Lord might not be able to protect him.

…

After chatting with his parents for a while as usual.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness returned to reality.

“Door to the Myriad Realms…”

Lin Yuan’s mind sank into the depths of his mind again.

Gazing at the majestic and grand Door to the Myriad Realms.

“Actually, after stepping into the Eighth Layer, the Door to the Myriad Realms is not without change.”

Lin Yuan observed the Door to the Myriad Realms carefully; at the Eighth Layer, his Spirit Will experienced a significant enhancement.

He vaguely felt that even if he performed traversals, arriving in other dimensions, other worlds,

with the aid of the Door to the Myriad Realms, he could still establish a connection with the Main World, instantly sensing everything happening around his physical body in the Main World.

This was essentially similar to Lin Yuan receiving information transmitted by the Ancestral Demon Tree through the coordinates of the Tianqing World.

If relying on Lin Yuan alone, it would be impossible to sense across dimensional layers to the other side.

Probably even a Supreme Being could not do it.

But with the aid of the Door to the Myriad Realms, having this object as a ‘medium,’ such a feat could be achieved.

“This is also good.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

During traversal, sensing every little detail around his physical body in the Main World was definitely a good thing.

Traversing to a lower-level world where the flow of time was immense, decades might pass there, while maybe only a few minutes gone by in the Main World.

But as the number of traversals increased, the levels of the worlds Lin Yuan arrived at became higher, and the flow of time relative to the Main World gradually reduced.

Resulting in the traversal duration becoming increasingly longer, what if a crisis occurred in the Main World during Lin Yuan’s traversal?

Wouldn’t he be powerless to resist?

Being able to sense the information around his physical self, however, gave Lin Yuan the opportunity to make a choice.

If a major crisis really occurred in the Main World, possibly endangering his physical body, Lin Yuan would surely end the traversal forcibly, his Spirit Will returning to take over his body.

Compared to losing one traversal, Lin Yuan valued his physical body more.

Not to mention the price Lin Yuan had paid on this physical body,

simply because the physical body was the Spirit Will’s ‘Guiding Mark’ upon return, Lin Yuan would not allow anything to happen to it.

“I wonder if I can bring the gourd along on the traversal…”

With a thought, Lin Yuan began to communicate with the Door to the Myriad Realms.

The Door to the Myriad Realms allowed for physical travel; naturally, it could also transport items.

It only required a certain amount of World-Breaking Origin Force.

During his seventh traversal, Lin Yuan had brought Origin Fine Gold into the Tianqing World and placed it within the World’s Origin Source for cultivation, saving him hundreds of years.

The gourd was also an external object which, logically, could be taken through the interdimensional travels.

“Hmm… Can it, also for a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force?”

Lin Yuan sighed in relief, not doubting whether the gourd could be transported but concerned that the Door to the Myriad Realms would demand ten or even dozens of strands of World-Breaking Origin Force from him.

“Just a single strand of World-Breaking Origin Force.”

Lin Yuan smiled faintly, now possessing nearly forty strands of World-Breaking Origin Force, which made him quite wealthy.

…

“I have nearly settled all matters.”

“It’s time for the eighth traversal.”

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts and made a decision.

Each traversal significantly enhanced his strength.

Being in the Fringe Starfield, Lin Yuan inevitably felt insecure and urgently needed to increase his strength.

“Which traversal method should I choose?”

Lin Yuan pondered internally.

Firstly, the random traversal method was somewhat unstable for Lin Yuan at present; it was better avoided if possible.

Excluding random traversal, the only option left was targeted traversal.

There were two types of targeted traversal, the first required one hundred strands of World-Breaking Origin Force and allowed choosing the travel world based on personal requirements.

The one hundred strands mentioned were just the starting point; if the chosen world’s tier was too high, the consumption of World-Breaking Origin Force would only be higher.

The second type required ten strands of World-Breaking Origin Force to descend into a world where he had coordinates.

Among the world coordinates Lin Yuan had, only two were worth revisiting.

One was the Tianqing World.

The other was the Spirit Realm.

The Tianqing World was his destination during the seventh traversal, where he had yet to thoroughly explore the Boundless Void.

Meanwhile, the Spirit Realm was considered the ‘Upper Realm’ of the Central Divine China World.

“Let’s traverse to the Spirit Realm this time”

Lin Yuan decided, knowing the Immortal Cultivation System would significantly aid the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, whereas encountering Foreign Evil Gods in the Boundless Void was comparatively less beneficial.

Thinking this, Lin Yuan sent a sliver of his spirit through the base of the Door to the Myriad Realms, integrating the Spirit Realm world coordinates into the Door.

With the assistance of the Door to the Myriad Realms.

Lin Yuan arrived outside a vast and immense world.

This world was familiar to Lin Yuan; during his time in the Central Divine Continent, he had broken through the void several times to look upon this colossal entity from the outside.

Compared to looking up at it back then, the sight was now much clearer; the mighty world forces in operation seemed capable of crushing everything.

“Are those million minor worlds beneath the Spirit Realm?”

Lin Yuan looked downward and saw countless lights, which he assumed were similar to the Lower Realms of Central Divine Continent.

It is said there are more than a million such Lower Realms.

“Hmm?”

“Above?”

Upon observing the Spirit Realm, Lin Yuan subconsciously looked upward.

He indeed spotted a corner of an even more vast world.

“Is there another world?”

“Could it be the legendary Immortal Realm?”

Lin Yuan was startled; in the numerous secret texts of the Daode Immortal Sect in the Central Divine Continent, he had read about another Immortal Realm above the Spirit Realm.

“Let’s focus on the Spirit Realm.”

Lin Yuan’s strand of spirit dispersed.

Outside the Door to the Myriad Realms.

Lin Yuan once again opened his eyes.

“The Immortal Realm?”

“Could that be the ultimate location of the Immortal Cultivation System?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself; he knew little about the Immortal Realm, to be precise, the Daode Immortal Sect had scant records of it.

If it weren’t for the occasional descents and communications of the immortals of successive generations, they probably wouldn’t have any records of the Immortal Realm at all.

“My stay in the Spirit Realm will likely last around nine hundred years.”

“Comparing time flow rates, about several hundred to one, after completing the stay, about one or two years would have passed in the Main World?”

Lin Yuan planned accordingly.

“Let’s start.”

Without hesitation, Lin Yuan communicated with the Door to the Myriad Realms, activated the Spirit Realm’s world coordinates, and his willpower abruptly surged into the Door.
